stories.title: The Verge 评论：Jensen Huang 复职凸显精英免责
stories.sourceTitle: Welcome to elite impunity, Jensen Huang

stories.title: AI 数据中心用电激增加剧 COP31 气候谈判分歧
stories.sourceTitle: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
stories.summary: The Verge 报道称，全球清洁能源转型正与高耗能 AI 数据中心扩张相撞，COP31 代表必须在谈判中处理这一新增电力需求。
stories.analysis: AI 基础设施扩张正从芯片供应问题外溢为能源与气候治理问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The clean energy revolution hinges on electrifying the entire global economy just as power-hungry data centers are surging. It's a challenge delegates from all over the world had to grapple with during the United Nations climate conference, called COP31, that

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Cisco 推出开源 Linux 运行时 Shirudo，用于打补丁时保护运行系统
stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.summary: 双方发布开源运行时 Shirudo，帮助团队在部署补丁期间保护正在运行的 Linux 系统。这是 OpenAI 在企业安全基础设施上的新合作延伸。
stories.analysis: 这显示 OpenAI 正把能力嵌入企业运维安全流程，而不只停留在模型 API。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

stories.title: Jensen Huang 如何重返 NVIDIA CEO：辞职与复职时间线
stories.sourceTitle: How Jensen Huang ended up as Nvidia CEO again
stories.summary: The Verge 梳理 Huang 从 11 月 12 日因围绕其被指婚外情的审查加剧而辞去 CEO，到随后重新掌舵 NVIDIA 的经过。
stories.analysis: 事件把 NVIDIA 的继任风险与创始人权力集中问题同时暴露出来。

stories.title: 特朗普介入 Jensen Huang 复职，被指制造高风险回归
stories.sourceTitle: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The Verge 称在 NVIDIA 董事会接受 Huang 辞任后，特朗普公开表态并推动其回归，报道将这一过程描述为政治力量介入公司治理。
stories.analysis: 创始人回归短期稳定军心，但政治背书会让 NVIDIA 的治理独立性受质疑。
stories.sourceExcerpt: After Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, following reports that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, President Donald Trump, too, appeared to submit to the new reality. Appearing on Stephen A. Smith's radio show shortly afte

stories.title: Nothing 将推 Ear Note 耳机：充电盒可录音并生成 AI 转写摘要
stories.sourceTitle: Nothing’s upcoming Ear Note is a pair of earbuds with AI transcription
stories.summary: Nothing 的新品 Ear Note 是一套带麦克风充电盒的耳机，可录制并转写对话，配套 App 管理录音、转写和 AI 摘要。可穿戴录音设备正把 AI 摘要做成日常功能。
stories.analysis: 这类产品会同时推动“随身记录”体验和隐私合规争议。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nothing's new AI device is the Ear Note, a set of earbuds and their microphone-equipped charging case that can record and transcribe conversations, with a connected app to manage the recordings, transcriptions and AI-generated summaries, similar to Apple's new

stories.title: 俄勒冈和弗吉尼亚起诉 SpaceX，指 Grok 未阻止色情深度伪造
stories.sourceTitle: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX over Grok’s porn deepfakes
stories.summary: 两州总检察长分别提起诉讼，指控 SpaceX 忽视行业安全措施并虚假宣传 Grok 的安全性，导致未经同意的色情深度伪造扩散。
stories.analysis: 州级消费者保护诉讼可能成为生成式 AI 内容责任的试验场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In separate but similar lawsuits filed on Monday, Oregon Attorney General Dan Rayfield and Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones accused SpaceX of violating state consumer protection laws by ignoring industry-standard safeguards and falsely promoting the safety

stories.title: Jensen Huang 复职后，NVIDIA 接下来要面对什么
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is back. What happens next?
stories.summary: The Verge 报道 Huang 承认与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的婚外情后，NVIDIA 曾宣布调查，但《纽约时报》称还有更多证据，随后 Huang 复职。文章讨论后续影响。
stories.analysis: 调查透明度与董事会独立性将决定复职能否修复信任。

stories.title: 白宫称特朗普“完全参与”Jensen Huang 复职
stories.sourceTitle: White House brags that Trump was ‘totally involved’ in getting Jensen reinstated
stories.summary: 白宫发言人公开表示特朗普“完全参与”并称赞 NVIDIA 董事会让 Huang 复职，证实政治层面介入。
stories.analysis: 白宫高调邀功会让企业治理事件进一步政治化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: It sure looked like President Donald Trump played a role in Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO - and now the White House is making sure everyone knows he was. "President Trump was totally involved and this is a great decision by the NVIDIA board," Whit

stories.title: 科技领袖庆祝 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，马斯克称“错误已被纠正”
stories.sourceTitle: Tech leaders are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return
stories.summary: The Verge 报道多位科技界人士欢迎 Huang 复职，尽管其此前因一系列被指不当行为离开公司。
stories.analysis: 行业站队反映出创始人与公司价值深度绑定，也淡化治理问责。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Let's say you're Jensen Huang. You (allegedly) cheated on your wife with an alleged Chinese spy, allegedly had an affair with not one, but two subordinates, and (allegedly!) "terrorized" your employees, a series of indiscretions that led to your ouster from wh

stories.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Ship：Claude 可自行审查、修复并批准 PR
stories.sourceTitle: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
stories.summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship 相关功能，使 Claude 能审查、修复并批准 pull request，帮助工程师加快代码交付。
stories.analysis: AI 编程代理从“写代码”走向“管代码”，代码审查权限和审计会成为企业落地关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests. Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Cl

stories.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship，让 AI 智能体处理代码审查、修复和批准
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称随着 AI 生成代码堆积，Claude Ship 让智能体接管常规审批环节，以减少开发瓶颈。
stories.analysis: 真正的竞争点将从生成代码质量转向代理能否安全进入合并流程。
stories.sourceExcerpt: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

stories.title: Supertake 融资 2000 万美元：用 AI 智能体把市场观点变成股票组合
stories.sourceTitle: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
stories.summary: Supertake 让用户表达市场判断，再由 AI 智能体构建股票组合，公司完成 2000 万美元融资。
stories.analysis: 若执行透明度和合规到位，这类产品可能降低主动投资门槛，但也会放大模型驱动的从众风险。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

stories.title: Amazon 以 75 亿美元收购 Decart AI 优化技术，为销售 Trainium 芯片铺路
stories.sourceTitle: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
stories.summary: Amazon 收购 Decart 的 AI 优化技术和研究团队，交易报道金额为 75 亿美元，背景是 Amazon 准备销售 Trainium 芯片。
stories.analysis: 亚马逊在用软件优化能力补硬件生态，试图让 Trainium 更具吸引力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.

stories.title: 马斯克等人欢迎 Jensen Huang 复职：称“错误已被纠正”
stories.sourceTitle: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道 Huang 在丑闻后复职，马斯克等科技人物公开表示欢迎。
stories.analysis: 公开庆祝把公司治理争议转化为阵营表态，进一步模糊问责焦点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.

stories.title: Jensen Huang 丑闻中心 Megaspeed 或将被列入美国黑名单
stories.sourceTitle: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
stories.summary: TechCrunch 称由 Alice Huang 此前领导的 Megaspeed 可能被列入美国黑名单，除非获得特别许可，否则将无法与美国公司做生意。
stories.analysis: 黑名单风险会切断其与美国芯片和云服务的联系，也可能扩大事件影响。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

stories.title: Jensen Huang 回 NVIDIA 总部，员工以英雄式欢迎
stories.sourceTitle: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
stories.summary: Huang 回到公司总部时受到员工英雄式欢迎，并称“第二次担任 CEO 我会做得更好”。
stories.analysis: 内部支持能短期稳团队，但外部审查不会因员工热情消失。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around," Huang told employees.

stories.title: Google AI Mode 接入 Drive 和 Wallet，提供更个性化搜索回答
stories.sourceTitle: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.summary: Google 将 Personal Intelligence 引入 AI Mode，并连接 Drive、Wallet 和 Gemini App，让搜索能基于用户数据给出更个性化回答。
stories.analysis: 谷歌正把搜索优势转化为个人上下文入口，但数据授权与隐私边界是成败关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that's already within its ecosystem

stories.title: Google 搜索推出个性化 AI Mode：可安全连接 Wallet、Drive 和 Gemini
stories.sourceTitle: A more tailored Google Search that’s uniquely yours
stories.summary: 用户可选择开启 Personal Intelligence，将 Google Wallet、Drive 和 Gemini App 连接到 AI Mode，获得更贴合个人情境的搜索回答。
stories.analysis: 这是谷歌用既有账号生态对抗 AI 搜索竞品的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Get more helpful Search responses by securely opting in to connect Google Wallet, Drive, and the Gemini app to Personal Intelligence in AI Mode.

stories.title: Jensen Huang 复职后将于下周赴美参议院作证
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: 在呼吁其就与疑似中国间谍的婚外情作证的两党呼声后，Huang 预计下周出席公开听证会。
stories.analysis: 国会听证会把 NVIDIA 治理问题升级为国家安全与出口管制议题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.

stories.title: TechCrunch：Jensen Huang 复职并不代表危机结束
stories.sourceTitle: Jensen Huang isn’t out of the woods yet
stories.summary: TechCrunch 评论认为，科技领袖应对 Huang 复职后可能引发的一系列问题保持清醒。
stories.analysis: 复职解决的是权力交接，不解决调查、信任和监管追问。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech leaders should be clear-eyed about all the problems likely to come with Huang's reinstatement.

stories.title: 报道称特朗普电话接入 NVIDIA 董事会，推动 Huang 回归
stories.sourceTitle: Trump reportedly called into Nvidia board meeting to advocate for Huang’s return
stories.summary: 特朗普对 CNBC 称自己与 NVIDIA 董事会通话并“说服了他们”让 Huang 复职。
stories.analysis: 总统直接介入董事会决策的报道，会让 NVIDIA 治理独立性成为持续争议。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "I spoke to them, let me put it that way … And I convinced them," the president told CNBC.

stories.title: OpenAI 谈企业内部法务的“连接式智能”
stories.sourceTitle: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
stories.summary: OpenAI 的 Stacey Wang、Craig Bruney 与 LECG、Cooley 人士讨论 AI 如何帮助内部法务连接业务上下文、构建可复用工作流并更好利用外部律师。
stories.analysis: 法律场景是高价值企业 AI 落地样本，关键在知识连接和流程复用而非单点问答。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

stories.title: Richpanel 用 GPT-6 系列模型帮企业在 30 天内自动化 50% 客服
stories.sourceTitle: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
stories.summary: Richpanel 使用 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 为客服智能体配备工具和流程，并用 GPT-6 Luna 处理对话，目标是在 30 天内自动化一半支持工作。
stories.analysis: 客服仍是企业 AI 最成熟场景，效果取决于工具调用和流程编排而非单模型能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

stories.title: 特朗普为 Huang 复职背书，称美国无不当行为证据
stories.sourceTitle: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
stories.summary: 特朗普引用美国司法部长为 Huang 回归辩护，同时敦促 NVIDIA 继续出口管制调查。
stories.analysis: 行政层背书与出口管制调查并行，显示政治支持无法替代合规审查。
stories.sourceExcerpt: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.

stories.title: 谷歌研究发现：技术债务会通过“智能体分心”让编码智能体偏离任务
stories.sourceTitle: 谷歌发现，技术债务会通过“智能体分心”导致编码智能体偏离正轨
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道，谷歌发现技术债务会以“智能体分心”的方式影响编码智能体，使其偏离原本任务。
stories.analysis: 这提醒团队，AI 编码代理的效果不仅取决于模型，也受代码库健康度制约。

stories.title: 蚂蚁 OceanBase 发布湖库一体 AI 数据平台 OceanLake，核心引擎全球开源
stories.sourceTitle: 蚂蚁OceanBase发布湖库一体AI数据平台OceanLake，核心引擎向全球开源
stories.summary: 蚂蚁 OceanBase 发布湖库一体 AI 数据平台 OceanLake，并将核心引擎向全球开源，报道称中国 AI 数据平台正在加速崛起。
stories.analysis: 开源核心引擎有助于争取开发者生态，但商业化与社区治理仍是后续考验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 中国AI数据平台加速崛起

stories.analysis: 安全模型前移到生成过程，有望降低实时应用中的违规输出和合规风险。
